query:
SELECT w.id, w.code, w.name, l.id as lineId, l.name as lineName 
FROM workshops w 
LEFT JOIN production_lines l ON l.workshopId = w.id
WHERE w.name LIKE '%SMT%' OR w.name LIKE '%Testing%';
